_comment_adding_properties: To add new gameplay properties: (1) Add field to each tileType entry above, (2) Add corresponding member to TileTypeProperties struct in TilePropertiesConfig.hpp, (3) Update LoadFromFile() deserialization in TilePropertiesConfig.cpp to read the new field, (4) Use the new property in your gameplay systems (GGGrid, pathfinding, etc.)
_comment_adding_types: To add new tile types: Copy an existing tileType object, increment tileTypeId, modify properties as needed. The tileTypeId must match the tileType value used in GGTileData.

_comment_property_meanings.tileTypeId: Unique integer ID matching GGTileData.tileType. Used to look up properties at runtime.
_comment_property_meanings.name: Human-readable name displayed in editor
_comment_property_meanings.isWalkable: Can units move through this tile? (pathfinding)
_comment_property_meanings.blocksVision: Does this tile block line of sight? (fog of war)
_comment_property_meanings.coverValue: Defense bonus (0.0 = no cover, 1.0 = full cover). Higher values reduce damage.
_comment_property_meanings.movementCost: Multiplier for movement points. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double cost, 999.0 = impassable.
_comment_property_meanings.isDestructible: Can this tile be destroyed by attacks?
_comment_property_meanings.defaultSpritePath: Default texture for this tile type (can be overridden per-tile)
